name: stim tab
text: A grey tab in wax paper. Military surplus, probably. It puts blood back where blood belongs.
useText: You tongue the stim. The dark gets a little less personal.

name: bent multitool
text: The driver is bent. It still punches. A courier's apology for a knife.

name: ceramic knife
text: Pale, sharp, and quiet. It does not show up on the old scanners. The old scanners are dead anyway.

name: chemical breather
text: A snout of rubber and glass. It makes the drowned corridors survivable and the air taste like coins.
useText: You seat the breather. The world smells like a hospital that lost an argument.

name: glowcapsule
text: A thumb of glass with a tired saint inside. Crack it only when the dark is working against you.
useText: You crack the glowcapsule. For a moment everything is the color of a cheap saint. In the ash well, this is enough to search by.

name: frayed cable
text: Copper, stolen by the weather and then by you. The market still pays for copper.

name: glass slag
text: A fist of orchard-glass, cooled wrong. Pretty, heavy, and worth a meal if you know the right table.

name: optic lens
text: An intact lens, warm from no sun you can name. It wants a cracked socket. Yours will do.
useText: You hold the lens to your cracked optic. Edges come back, including edges you could have lived without.

name: clean filter
text: A filter that has not yet learned the ash. Doc Hex would trade medicine for it. Anyone else would trade less.

name: insulated gloves
text: Thick, ugly, rated for a voltage the city no longer admits to having. The rooftop cable disagrees.
useText: You pull on the gloves. Your fingers go dull. Live wire would go duller.

name: ash shard
text: White, warm, etched with a flame the size of a fingernail. Half a municipal key.

name: black wafer
text: A black wafer, heavier than it looks. The other half of the key. Juniper calls it a future. She is not wrong.

name: protocol key
text: Shard and wafer, knit. It is the size of a fingerbone and it hums in the key of a tram bell.

name: cipher tape
text: A strip of metal punched with holes. The red grid will understand it. You will not.
useText: The tape is warm. Hold it to the red grid under the pit and walk south.

name: ferry token
text: A punched coin on a dirty string. The Ferryman pretends not to prefer these to stories.

name: crystal ball
text: A fist of orchard-glass that fogs when it is thinking. It does not predict. It repeats, and only to the hands on it.
